business.summary: Automotive software/ER&D partner to global OEMs (~$730M revenue run-rate per Q4 FY26 investor meet). Pivoting from services to solutions + products (Qorix middleware JV, Caresoft and N-Dream acquisitions, Cymotive). Two largest OEM clients (Europe and Asia passenger cars) are ramping down; CV/off-highway and products are the offsets. ~9% of revenue from 'AI-first' projects; fixed-price share ~70% (Q2 FY27 concall).

segments.name: Passenger cars (down ~8% YoY in Q2 FY27)
Commercial & off-highway (+27% YoY in Q2 FY27)

promises.promise: Q4 FY26 will be the highest quarterly growth of FY26.
promises.delivered: Q4 FY26 revenue ₹1,711 Cr, +5.8% QoQ vs +0.7%/+3.2%/+1.8% in Q1-Q3 — highest, though helped by a full quarter of Caresoft.

promises.promise: Profitability will improve from Q3 levels in Q4 despite investments.
promises.delivered: Operating profit ₹311 → ₹317 Cr but OPM 19.2% → 18.5% (results filings); PAT rose ₹133 → ₹163 Cr mainly on other income swing (-₹26 → +₹12 Cr).

promises.promise: FY27 will grow 'for sure' faster than FY26.
promises.delivered: H1 FY27 revenue ₹3,366 Cr, +7.6% YoY in INR (inorganic-aided) but CC growth ~0.1-0.2% YoY in Q1/Q2; Q1 FY27 fell 3.6% QoQ in CC (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls).

promises.promise: EBITDA margin to expand from ~20% to 22-24% via solutions/products mix.
promises.delivered: Company EBITDA 17.2% (Q1 FY27) and 17.8% (Q2 FY27); screener OPM 15-16%. Moving away from the band, not toward it.

promises.promise: $950M-1B revenue in ~3 years, with $550-600M from solutions and products.
promises.delivered: Revenue flat in CC over Q1-Q2 FY27; products +25% YoY in Q2 FY27 is the only line on trajectory.

promises.promise: H2 FY27 better than H1; return to growth led by Q4; margins recover with revenue.
promises.delivered: Q2 FY27 CC +0.5% QoQ, EBITDA 17.2% → 17.8%; mgmt reiterates H2 > H1 but now says growth comes back 'early part of next year' (Q2 FY27 concall).

promises.promise: Two largest OEM accounts will start to stabilise in Q3 FY27; CV growth to show in Q2/Q3.
promises.delivered: CV/off-highway +27% YoY, +17.6% QoQ in Q2 (kept). But revenue from the top-2 OEMs fell >13%; consolidation now seen concluding by end-Q1 FY28 (Q2 FY27 concall).

promises.promise: Qorix to win its 'fair share' as part of the EU software partnership.
promises.delivered: Qorix losses hit PAT in Q1 FY27; in Q2 FY27 mgmt said its programs 'have been pushed out by a couple of years'.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Strong deal wins and a positive pipeline will convert to growth (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue ₹1,711 → ₹1,675 → ₹1,691 Cr over Q4 FY26-Q2 FY27; CC YoY ~0%. Deal-to-revenue conversion H1 ~57% vs 75-80% a year ago (Q2 FY27 concall).

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Mix shift to products lifts margins (Q2 FY27: EBITDA +60 bps QoQ).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: True QoQ (17.2% → 17.8%) but OPM down from 21% (Q4 FY25) to 16% (Q2 FY27) on screener; PAT ₹121 Cr vs ₹245 Cr in Q4 FY25.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: CV/off-highway is a durable offset to passenger-car weakness.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: CV/off-highway +27% YoY in Q2 FY27 while passenger cars -8% YoY (Q2 FY27 concall).

guidance.guide: H2 FY27 better than H1; growth returns early FY28; no numeric guide
Meaningfully concluded by end of Q1 FY28
Detailed parameters (incl. products reporting) to be given with Q4 FY27

bull: CV/off-highway +27% YoY and products +25% YoY in Q2 FY27 — the diversification away from 2 large PV clients is working (Q2 FY27 concall).
89% of wins from target accounts; fixed-price ~70-71% of revenue and ~9% from AI-first projects (Q2 FY27 concall).
EBITDA turned up 60 bps QoQ to 17.8% on mix, before any revenue recovery (Q2 FY27 concall).
bear: Growth promise kept slipping: 'better FY27' (Q3 FY26) → 'growth by Q4' (Q1 FY27) → 'early next year' (Q2 FY27).
Margin target 22-24% (Q4 FY26) vs delivered 17.2-17.8%; PAT ₹121 Cr in Q2 FY27 vs ₹169 Cr a year earlier (results filings).
Top-2 OEM revenue down >13%; Qorix programs pushed out by ~2 years with ongoing share of losses (Q2 FY27 concall).
